text: Full-time remote employees are eligible for a monthly home office stipend of $250 to cover internet and utilities expenses.
Effective June 1 2024, the monthly home office stipend for all remote employees is increased to $400. This replaces all prior remote stipend policies.
Frequently Asked Questions: Remote employees receive a $300 monthly reimbursement for home office internet.
Company Security Policy: All laptops used for company work must have full-disk encryption enabled (FileVault on macOS, BitLocker on Windows).
IT Department Memo: Full-disk encryption is optional for laptops if biometric login (Touch ID / Windows Hello) is enabled.
Travel Operations Memo: The standard domestic meal per diem reimbursement rate is $75 per day.
Accounting Memo: The daily domestic meal reimbursement cap for business travel is set to $90 per day.
Expense Reimbursement Policy: Itemized receipts are strictly required for any business expense exceeding $50.
